in_marathi.name: Dharanidhar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Holder of Dharma
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharanidhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dharanidhar is a Sanskrit word composed of two parts: Dhara (to hold) and Nidh (treasure). It signifies a person who holds the treasure of Dharma (righteousness) in his heart and upholds it in his actions.
